labels: The intricacies of high school life.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Does that mean I'm... I'm... eligible?
She's too happy to speak when he nods slowly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: As long as your last photos show the same quality and thoughtfulness you've put into these.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Er, well...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And on we go, continue, proceed!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And judging from everything I've witnessed here... You are not fit to be an artist.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Surprised? A true artist wouldn't feel surprised, astonished, or taken aback by my words. She would just `know.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Surprised? A true artist wouldn't feel surprised, astonished, or taken aback by my words. She would just [color=#e23b3b][i]know.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's as ridiculous as... As flying pigs!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: In the time we've spent, you haven't displayed anything of an artistic sense at all. Your photos may be good, but I suspect it's more a matter of luck and the camera you wield than talent.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: A true artist would never fall into that trap.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And you, Autumn, are not a `true artist.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And you, Autumn, are not a [color=#e23b3b][i]true artist.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I don't need to see any more. I'm done here.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No! Wait! I know what my weaknesses are! I can explain!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: No... I'm afraid you can't.
Her shoulders slump as Mr. Vanderwall walks past her and out...
Autumn slumps to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's one of the most well-known art professionals here... If `he` thinks I'm a terrible artist...
nodes.text_bbcode: He's one of the most well-known art professionals here... If [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] thinks I'm a terrible artist...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe I should turn in my photo lab card and quit photography all together...
Autumn has failed, not passed, flunked!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was happy to do it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But if you'll excuse me, I'm going to stand outside again... Paige could be here any minute.
He walks out the doors, and $ZOE gives Autumn a sad smile.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's waiting for Paige?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, he is. I'm sorry, Autumn, but I need to get a glass of lemonade. Go on without me?
She walks away.
One minute passes...
Autumn checks her phone to see if $ZOE texted.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm sure he'll be here any second...
Another minute passes...
And another...
And another...
And another...
Until finally...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess he--
She spots $ZOE and Owen rushing up to the photos.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Autumn. We got caught up waiting for Paige...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's okay... Mr. Vanderwall, this is Owen, the subject of the photo.
Out of breath and slightly disoriented, Owen limply shakes Mr. Vanderwall's hand with a sweaty palm.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: How... Moist.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Er, sorry about that. I ran pretty fast to get here...
Owen shifts his weight from foot to foot uncertainly. He scratches his head.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is there anything you'd, uh, like to ask me?
Vanderwall eyes him, unimpressed.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I see Autumn's photos may have over-exaggerated your positive qualities...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?
Mr. Vanderwall sniffs and turns to Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Well, then, I have seen enough.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Impressive. Good artists appreciate and understand how small details contribute to the full effect.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No, uh... The idea is that Ben's `focused.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, uh... The idea is that Ben's [color=#3b78e2][i]focused.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Oh... Yes! He `is` focused now that I look at him.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Yes! He [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] focused now that I look at him.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Though it is rather worrisome that you aren't familiar with the details of your photos...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I know, but I `do` notice them...
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] notice them...

nodes.text: He says nothing, brushing past her towards the next set of photos...
Autumn turns back to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ben, thanks for being a subject. Your focus was great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wish I were more focused lately...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, you were mentioning something about talking with your father?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes. Emily wants me to have a big heart-to-heart with him. But my relationship with my father is what it is. Nothing's wrong, and I don't want to change it...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The people we love affect us in more ways than we know. In any case, it sounds like Emily is trying to look out for you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just wish she hadn't staked a basketball game on it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'll deal with it. You should catch up with Vanderguy before he gets carried away...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, I should. Thanks again!
Autumn and Mr. Vanderwall move to another portion of the gallery where Owen's photos are.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: So what made you choose 'strength', 'passion', and 'focus'?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It seemed like a well-rounded trio. Strength is physical, passion is emotional, focus is more mental.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: An excellent theme. And the young man in these photos exudes such strength! Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, Owen? Uh... $ZOE went to find him, but I'm not sure where they went...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: So the basketball and the beaker are the focal points of both photos?
Mr. Vanderwall tilts his head to the side quizzically...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean to say he has an excellent awareness of lab and basketball safety? That's hardly `deep`, insightful, or thoughtful...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean to say he has an excellent awareness of lab and basketball safety? That's hardly [color=#e23b3b][i]deep[/i][/color], insightful, or thoughtful...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: So the basketball and his eyes are the focal points of both photos?
Mr. Vanderwall tilts his head to the side quizzically...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean to say he has excellent hand-eye coordination? That's hardly `deep`, insightful, or thoughtful...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not sure I understand. Do you mean to say he has excellent hand-eye coordination? That's hardly [color=#e23b3b][i]deep[/i][/color], insightful, or thoughtful...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe the beaker?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Interesting...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And in this photo?
He gestures to the photo of Ben fixing his gaze intently at a beaker he holds steadily in one hand.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And of course in this one, you should notice...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... Um... I'm not sure.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The... Basketball?
While $ZOE was talking to Owen...
Autumn and Mr. Vanderwall come up to Ben's photos where Ben is observing them. He waves when they appear.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hi Autumn. Great pictures. You know, when you said I had to tinker with lab instruments, I didn't think it'd look this good.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: 'Good' is all relative. It is whether or not these photos are 'relatable' that is the `true` art. When your photography can speak to an audience, then it is art.
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Good' is all relative. It is whether or not these photos are 'relatable' that is the [color=#e23b3b][i]true[/i][/color] art. When your photography can speak to an audience, then it is art.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Does it speak to you?
Mr. Vanderwall takes a closer look at the photos.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And what is the subject, the theme, the primary attribute of these photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Wait! Do not tell me. I wish to guess on my own. That will truly tell me if the photo is relatable or if it's merely a photo of a jock boy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Can I give hints?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Give me focal points. What do you wish me to notice on both of his photos?
Autumn gestures to the first photo of Ben in the middle of a basketball play, his eyes up at the basket as he deftly handles the ball.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Notice...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's nice, but you don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's all right. Her being an hour late is a little weird. I want to make sure nothing's happened to her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And at least we can catch up... Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've called her, but she's not picking up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could try calling.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm not her favorite person in the world.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're so nice. How could you not be anyone's favorite person?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, being nice doesn't always win you friends. Especially not with Paige. In fact, I think she has more of an incentive `not` to pick up my phone call.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, being nice doesn't always win you friends. Especially not with Paige. In fact, I think she has more of an incentive [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] to pick up my phone call.

nodes.text: They lapse into silence as the minutes tick on, but there's no sign of Paige.
$ZOE glances at the time on her phone, hoping she's not making Autumn wait `too` long...
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE glances at the time on her phone, hoping she's not making Autumn wait [b]too[/b] long...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll wait `for` you. As in... I'll stay here, and you go in and talk to Autumn's man for a couple minutes.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll wait [color=#3b78e2][i]for[/i][/color] you. As in... I'll stay here, and you go in and talk to Autumn's man for a couple minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When Paige gets here, I'll let you know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay... Are you sure?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. I'm sure. Autumn needs you there now.
$ZOE waits until he's back inside before she allows a sad look to cross her face. She scans the parking lot for a sign of Paige.
He leads the way to the next photo. $ZOE and Autumn hang just behind him.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben? Well, uh, I don't know what to say. He's my boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Autumn, I'm afraid I don't see the connection between her boyfriend and your photos...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Vanderwall, human emotion doesn't exist in a vacuum. It comes out of the complex relationships we have with others around us.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ben is one of the ways in which Emily expresses her passion.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You can say that again. Lately, Ben's been really pushing it. Usually, he's so nice and understanding...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But lately, he's been `so` infuriating! I wish he'd just `listen` to me on this!
nodes.text_bbcode: But lately, he's been [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] infuriating! I wish he'd just [color=#3b78e2][i]listen[/i][/color] to me on this!

nodes.text: The outburst leaves her flustered, and she sucks in a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry. We're kind of in the middle of a fight, and he's being so stubborn. Is it really that hard for him to have a simple conversation with his dad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes the conversations with people you love are the hardest to have...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess that's true. I didn't exactly relish the idea of talking with my dad about my sister, so maybe I get some of it.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Anyway, I... I need some air. I'm sorry.
She hurries off to find Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sorry, Mr. Vanderwall, it's not Emily's `best` night--
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, Mr. Vanderwall, it's not Emily's [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] night--

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Excellent! Marvelous! Stupendous! Did you see how she articulated her anger? You captured her passion perfectly!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I applaud your efforts on this portrait, and I cannot wait to see the next.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And if the subject of your next portrait is around, I'd much like to meet him.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: You are an aquatic athlete, a swimmer, a nautical juggernaut?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't think anyone's ever called me a 'juggernaut' before...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I am a swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And what do you think of the sport?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's like any sport, I guess. I mean, it has its ups and downs...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I haven't been as into it lately...
She shrugs and looks around uncomfortably.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, guys, I think I need some air. I'll be right back...
She hurries off to find Kimi, and Autumn looks to Mr. Vanderwall.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I didn't see nearly any of the spark that you caught in these photos...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: She's having an off day. But I swear, normally, she's much more energetic...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's in a fight with her boyfriend...
He sniffs, incredulous.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Let us move on to the next, shall we?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: And if the subject of your next portrait is around, I'd much like to... Judge `his` character.
nodes.text_bbcode: And if the subject of your next portrait is around, I'd much like to... Judge [color=#e23b3b][i]his[/i][/color] character.

nodes.text: They follow Mr. Vanderwall to Emily's photos.
Mr. Vanderwall follows Autumn to the first exhibit of Emily. He scans both photos of Emily and then looks down at the chalkboard where 'Passion' is written in neat letters.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: I find this set fascinating. You as an artist should know that the most important thing to do in an art exhibit such as this is getting to the `heart` of the `art.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I find this set fascinating. You as an artist should know that the most important thing to do in an art exhibit such as this is getting to the [color=#e23b3b][i]heart[/i][/color] of the [color=#e23b3b][i]art.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Your photos show a lot of depth of emotion, and the 'passion' that shows up in this girl's photos is remarkable. She must be very passionate in real life.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh yes, very much so. But don't get her wrong. She's not so intensely passionate in person.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: You mean, she's not like her photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: If your subject is nothing like your photos, then what you've printed would be a `lie...` It would be lacking the very 'truth' or 'heart' that it needs to be convincing.
nodes.text_bbcode: If your subject is nothing like your photos, then what you've printed would be a [color=#e23b3b][i]lie...[/i][/color] It would be lacking the very 'truth' or 'heart' that it needs to be convincing.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, I mean, she `is` passionate. Just not in a crazy way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I mean, she [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] passionate. Just not in a crazy way.

nodes.text: Vanderwall eyes her suspiciously, and suddenly, Autumn has an idea.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You should meet her. You could see for yourself how well I've caught her in portrait.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: An excellent idea.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You could meet all the models, if you wanted. They're all here tonight and...
Autumn's smile fades when she sees $ZOE's surprised look. And Autumn suddenly remembers that most of her subjects are distracted with their personal lives.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Let them show themselves then.
With no choice, Autumn nods at Emily who's standing a few feet away from her exhibit. Emily gives Mr. Vanderwall a tight, wary smile as she walks up.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Emily.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Emily. You're the inspiration behind these photos of 'passion'. Of course I'd like to hear more about how you came to be the subject, the inspiration, the focal point!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's nothing I did. Autumn has a good eye for picture-taking.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It helps that you have such strong interests. Emily, tell Mr. Vanderwall about...
Vanderwall ponders that for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: How does your photo shoot speak about that?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Um... The photos are of high schoolers? So the photos capture parts of their high school life?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Just looking around at the photos, I would not have guessed 'high school life.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not about just that, sir. It's also about characteristics. Autumn explained to me the other day that she wanted to capture two sides of the same attribute.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Now `that` is something I understand more.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] is something I understand more.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: But it is not a good sign when the artist cannot articulate her own vision. Not a good sign at all.
When he turns his back, Autumn whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `That` could've gone better.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] could've gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not `you`.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... Right.
Vanderwall ponders that for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Please elaborate.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, every photo set centers around one particular attribute or human characteristic such as strength.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The two photos in each set show different ways that characteristic can be interpreted or shown.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Excellent. You speak well of your purpose, and you have a clear vision for your art. Please. Show me around.
And with that, he strides forward. Behind his back, Autumn winks at $ZOE.
When he turns his back, Autumn whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `That` could've gone better.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] could've gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not `you`.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... Right.
Vanderwall's face turns a deep shade of red.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: No point?! There's `always` a point to art.
nodes.text_bbcode: No point?! There's [color=#e23b3b][i]always[/i][/color] a point to art.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: If there is no idea or purpose behind what you are doing, it is `not` art. It's merely... `Entertainment.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If there is no idea or purpose behind what you are doing, it is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] art. It's merely... [color=#e23b3b][i]Entertainment.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I `did` enjoy the photo shoot...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] enjoy the photo shoot...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: But `enjoyment` is only a small part of the process. `Purpose` is everything. If you have no purpose...
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#e23b3b][i]enjoyment[/i][/color] is only a small part of the process. [color=#e23b3b][i]Purpose[/i][/color] is everything. If you have no purpose...

nodes.text: $ZOE steps in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, there is a point to Autumn's photo shoot... She spent a lot of time looking for key emotions in every photo.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: So it is `human attributes` you are attempting to catalogue.
nodes.text_bbcode: So it is [color=#e23b3b][i]human attributes[/i][/color] you are attempting to catalogue.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Yes, I see it now.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: But it is not a good sign when the artist is confused about her own medium or her own purpose. Not a good sign at all.
When he turns his back, Autumn whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `That` could've gone better.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] could've gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not `you`.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... Right.
Caught off guard, Autumn fumbles.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... Um... There is... No point?
When he turns his back, Autumn whispers to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `That` could've gone better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's fine. Relax, he came to evaluate your photos, not `you`.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... Right.
Kimi gives $ZOE an apologetic shrug as she follows her friend to the snack table.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It doesn't feel like the best night for everyone to be out...  Ben and Emily seem upset. Lindsay is, well, Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'd been hoping to introduce the models to someone important... I hope they'll be up for talking to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least we don't have to worry about Owen...
Just then, they see Owen get out of his car and walk to the doors...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Speaking of...
They see Owen get out of his car and walk to the doors.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hi, guys! Autumn, everything looks great!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks, but I couldn't have done it without $ZOE here...
Autumn glances at $ZOE and grins.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Anyway, I think I see someone I absolutely `have` to talk to. I'll catch up with you two later.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I think I see someone I absolutely [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to talk to. I'll catch up with you two later.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you came, Owen. Your photos turned out great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think I've really seen you since Paige's party... And things got pretty crazy at the end. How are you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good. What about you? Did you have a good weekend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of... Sam tried to drag me out on a fake date with her and Nick for Valentine's Day...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yikes... Third wheel much?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I managed to excuse myself... And it turns out, they totally did want it to be a date.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Isn't that weird? I thought Sam and Nick had a history. A bad one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It is a little strange, but I hope it will work out. If they can put away their past, maybe they'll have a good future ahead of them...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's a nice way of seeing it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So did you do anything for Valentine's Day?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Kind of. I actually forgot that Valentine's Day was last week. `Paige` had to remind--
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Kind of. I actually forgot that Valentine's Day was last week. [color=#e23b3b][i]Paige[/i][/color] had to remind--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, uh, er... Yes. I saw her. We, uh, hung out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's... Going through a hard time. So I saw her after the party. She's... Stressed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's too bad... She's kind of a handful when she's `not` stressed...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that's too bad... She's kind of a handful when she's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] stressed...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha. Yes, she sure is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you and Paige are... Uh... Are...
$ZOE is saved from having to finish her awkward question when Autumn waves her into the gallery.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Owen... Autumn needs me.
While $ZOE rushes to Autumn's side, Owen grimaces to himself.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You just had to mention Paige, didn't you? At least she knows...
You are now playing as Autumn.
A couple minutes earlier...
Autumn sips lemonade to calm her nerves, while she watches $ZOE and Owen talk near the doors.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I saw how you gave $ZOE and Owen time together alone just now. You know something.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, what are you doing here? Have some shady business dealings in the area?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Heh. Amusing, and yes. But I also appreciate the arts. Support your local artist and all that.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Besides, maybe I like to keep tabs on what you're doing once in a while.
Autumn hides her blush by taking another sip of lemonade. She clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Only to use it against me another day, I'm sure.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm a negotiator at heart. And I deal in information.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Why must you make everything you do sound so sketchy?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: 'Sketchy'? ...Or `mysterious?`
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Sketchy'? ...Or [color=#e23b3b][i]mysterious?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh-huh. So what do you think of the gallery?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Art... Has never been my thing. But you've done well. At least that's from what I can tell, being an amateur photographer myself...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Amateur photographer? Like you take pictures of people cheating on tests?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's art in a way... The vices of life. I wish I had a camera as unique as yours. It's your mother's, isn't it? It gives photos that effect.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What effect?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That dream-like quality. Which is very apt for a dreamer like you. The camera suits you. Your photos are fascinating.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thanks... I hope other people find them interesting.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you trying to impress someone?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, there is `someone`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there is [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `That` I didn't know...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] I didn't know...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, maybe you don't know everyone as well as you think.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And here he comes now.
Autumn waves to a tall, older gentleman in the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Hello!
He makes his way over.
Wes lets out a nearly imperceptible sigh.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A little old for you, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ha ha, yeah right. He's a professional in the art industry, and I'm interested in his opinions. If you'll excuse me...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Autumn, before you go... I'm interested in `your` opinions. You don't mind if I find you after the Art Showcase?
nodes.text_bbcode: Autumn, before you go... I'm interested in [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] opinions. You don't mind if I find you after the Art Showcase?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... No!
Wes raises his lemonade glass at her, grins, and blends into the crowd. Autumn stares after him for a moment...
Then she summons $ZOE over, and together, they meet the man.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: You must be Autumn. A pleasure at last! I am Leopold Vanderwall. I glanced over your exhibits on my way in, and I must say, I am looking forward to discussing each with you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Vanderwall, it would be my pleasure, but before that, there's someone I'd like you to meet...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This is $ZOE. She's the one who helped organize the Art Showcase.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello! How do you know Autumn?
At first Mr. Vanderwall seems about to answer, but Autumn cuts him off.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Vanderwall is an important voice in the artistic community.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's seen photos I've taken before, and I invited him to come see my art in action.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you work for a gallery?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: No. I'm--

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: He's an art consultant.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Yes. I have quite a fascination with new and upcoming artists. I knew after I'd seen Autumn's work that I must meet the mind behind the art.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll enjoy the show then... Shall we go through it?
$ZOE and Autumn move towards the first set of portraits, but Vanderwall stops them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Before we begin, I must prepare myself for what I am about to see...
He closes his eyes and passes a hand over his face. When he opens his eyes again, Autumn is surprised by the intensity in them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Art cannot be art without thought. What is the thinking, the philosophy, the mind behind your photos?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The philosophy of my gallery? I've taken two photos of each of my subjects to compare the photos to one another.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: That is the `method` to your art. But what message are you trying to tell the world? What is the point of your exhibit? What is the theme?
nodes.text_bbcode: That is the [color=#e23b3b][i]method[/i][/color] to your art. But what message are you trying to tell the world? What is the point of your exhibit? What is the theme?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh.... The point of my photos is to show...

options.label: The intricacies of high school life.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `He's` annoyed? I'm the one who should be upset!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]He's[/i][/color] annoyed? I'm the one who should be upset!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `He's` the one parading around, thinking that everything is fine with his life. When it's not...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]He's[/i][/color] the one parading around, thinking that everything is fine with his life. When it's not...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe 'annoyed' wasn't the right word. He's just... Frustrated.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He's the one who's frustrating `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: He's the one who's frustrating [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily angrily walks off.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Is he?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, he must be really torn up about your fight...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe I said some harsh things...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But I didn't know what else to do.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Things will work out. I bet if you two talk, you'll figure it out.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If only I was the person that he needed to talk to...
She strides away, deep in thought.
She walks in the direction $ZOE is pointing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Enjoy yourselves!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We will. We heard there were free hors d'oeuvres!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` free horde swerves! Those are like cars, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] free horde swerves! Those are like cars, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, they're snacks, Amanda. You eat them?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't get it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll show you. See you around, $ZOE!
They walk off as Ben and Spencer come up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm ready for my moment in the spotlight. Where am I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Since you and Emily are the stars of our show, Autumn put the two of you close to one another. You're right next to Emily!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong? Where is Emily?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, you know, she's kind of--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: --Seriously pissed at him. They got into a fight.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Spencer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Spencer.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, man, it's better this way. Now you don't have to boo-hoo to `me` about all this stuff anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, man, it's better this way. Now you don't have to boo-hoo to [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] about all this stuff anymore!

nodes.text: Spencer turns to $ZOE and Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ben's been a complete sad sack all day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Will you stop calling me that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What else do you call a guy who mopes around?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's right. A `sad` sack.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right. A [color=#e23b3b][i]sad[/i][/color] sack.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's too long to get into. But basically, if I don't talk to my dad, Emily's not going to come to the Sectionals game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But she doesn't get it. It's not easy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Ben. Is there anything I can do to help?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not even sure what `I'm` going to do.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not even sure what [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure everything will be all right. Just try to enjoy the show. You know, stay `focused.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure everything will be all right. Just try to enjoy the show. You know, stay [color=#3b78e2][i]focused.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks.
Ben and Spencer start going through the gallery. Emily and Kimi come in shortly after.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily, Kimi... Welcome!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks! It's kind of fun to see Emily in a photo shoot. I'm so jealous! It's like you're Hollywood.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I wish you'd have let me lend you a shirt or `something`... I have a gray one that'd look great with your eyes...
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish you'd have let me lend you a shirt or [color=#3b78e2][i]something[/i][/color]... I have a gray one that'd look great with your eyes...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure. Hey, $ZOE, is Ben here yet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. He just arrived. Are, uh, are you two okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess Ben must have mentioned it to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's more like Spencer mentioned it to me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course he did. Ugh, Ben is being so stubborn!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He seems pretty...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know... You save the best things for last?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Really?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, it's the last portrait people see. It'll leave more of an impact.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Oooh, I like the sound of that. Where is it again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just behind that statue.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Why is `that` a good thing? It just makes it look like my photos aren't even part of this stupid art show.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] a good thing? It just makes it look like my photos aren't even part of this stupid art show.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not what I meant at all! I just mean that it's in a room by itself, so maybe people will pay more attention to it.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I `guess...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]guess...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least take a look at it before you get too mad. It's just behind that statue.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Whatever the reason, thank you. None of this would have happened without you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: After Lindsay destroyed all my photos, I wasn't sure this was ever going to be in the cards.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just happy that people will be able to see your art.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh yeah... A lot of people are coming, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't know whether to be excited or sick to my stomach!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd rather you be excited.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ha ha. I'll try. But I'm so nervous...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you even have to be nervous about?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, there will be a ton of people... A lot of students, the principal... And I have a special guest coming to see my photos.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Special guest, huh? Like a `guy` special guest?
nodes.text_bbcode: Special guest, huh? Like a [color=#3b78e2][i]guy[/i][/color] special guest?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No! Not like `that.` Just someone I want to impress. And I want you to meet him with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Not like [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color] Just someone I want to impress. And I want you to meet him with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! Let me know when he's here. And don't worry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's going to be great. Everything's perfect. People just have to show up and have a good time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And everyone will love your work.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I wish my mother could see me now. My photos wouldn't be the same without her camera.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The one that makes everything slightly out of focus?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah. She gave it to me before she passed away. It's one of the few things I have left of her, and it makes me so happy to use it.
Autumn looks fondly at the camera she's put on display next to her photos.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure she'd be proud.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, look! People are arriving!
$ZOE and Autumn go to the gallery's main entrance doors, which lead out into the parking lot.
At the doors to the auditorium, guests stream in. $ZOE and Autumn stand by to greet them.
Sam and Nick wander up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! You're here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I'm here. You only talked my ear off about it for the last week.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really wanted you to come.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Nick, I'm glad you made it too.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... Sam only talked my ear off about it for the last week.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... What can I say? We're related. Well, come in! Autumn worked very hard on this exhibit.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You can start over this way...
Autumn points them in the direction of the exhibit's start as Lindsay and the cheerleaders walk up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What up, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You came!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I had to see what was taking up your entire life...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Since you've only been putting in the minimum amount of practice time lately...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... But after the Art Showcase...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You'll be around. This looks nice, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Where are `my` photos?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where are [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] photos?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Oh yeah, I want to see how those turned out... Lindsay's been bragging about them all day.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I have `not.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I have [color=#3b78e2][i]not.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: There's a second room in the back. I hung your photos there.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: In the back? `Seriously?`
nodes.text_bbcode: In the back? [color=#3b78e2][i]Seriously?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The angry look on Lindsay's face renders Autumn speechless.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh...
$ZOE steps in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not a bad thing, Lindsay. Your photo's in the back...

options.label: So it can be viewed separately.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh... So you're only doing this because it's your job?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's my job to make sure that we have events that are fun for everyone in the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we need to support the arts. Besides, I think this is really fun!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know... Sometimes you are `way` too nice and a little `scarily` optimistic...
nodes.text_bbcode: You know... Sometimes you are [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too nice and a little [color=#3b78e2][i]scarily[/i][/color] optimistic...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But I'm glad we met.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: As I've said before... Artists are like the gum stuck under the table. So this really is a great opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, today... Artists are like the...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, trays of food `above` the table?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, trays of food [color=#3b78e2][i]above[/i][/color] the table?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ha ha, close enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll leave the similes to you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: We are?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We aren't?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, like I said, I'm `grateful`, but we only met a couple weeks ago...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, like I said, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]grateful[/i][/color], but we only met a couple weeks ago...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And it's not that I don't like you or anything, but... We don't really hang out apart from the Showcase planning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That is very true...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe that's something I'd like to fix.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: All right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, whether or not we're friends, I have a duty to support the arts. And I take it very seriously.
$ZOE surveys her work just as Autumn walks in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you fix the gallery map?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... Now everyone's going to see Lindsay's photos last. I think that's the best place for them since they're a little different than the others.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How did the labeling go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I managed. What do you think?
Autumn walks over to the photos and examines each of the chalkboards to see what attributes $ZOE has written.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You got every one right! Thanks!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yay! I'm going to grab the cookies, and then we'll be all set!
$ZOE ducks into the kitchen and lays the cookie trays out on tables in the art exhibition.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, uh... It looks good... For the most part.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have forgotten one or two...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's okay. We have a couple minutes...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right. I'll... Get the lemonade and cookies...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yikes, you really didn't remember anything from the photo shoots...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just... Get the lemonade and cookies, will you?
$ZOE ducks into the kitchen. When she comes back, Autumn has fixed the labels so that Owen is 'Strength', Emily is 'Passion', Ben is 'Focus', and Lindsay is 'Pretty'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: There. `Now` we're ready...
nodes.text_bbcode: There. [color=#3b78e2][i]Now[/i][/color] we're ready...

nodes.text: Autumn and $ZOE look over the gallery. Autumn's photos look professionally displayed, each illuminated under a warm light.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This looks great! I can't wait for things to start. Turns out hosting an Art Showcase `is` exciting!
nodes.text_bbcode: This looks great! I can't wait for things to start. Turns out hosting an Art Showcase [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] exciting!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... I'm really grateful for your help, but I am curious. If you don't mind me asking... Why are you helping me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about? I want to help!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Is that all it is?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's also because...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
$ZOE struggles to think of the word...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, that's right. It's `pretty.`
$ZOE writes down the trait and walks to Lindsay's photos. Both show Lindsay with a flattering halo of light around her face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't take much to remember this one. Lindsay didn't want to be described by an emotion or trait. She just wanted to be...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Patience, maybe? She's got to be if she trains so hard.
She scribbles that down and moves to Emily's exhibit. One of Emily's photos shows her in the pool, and the other shows the unbridled joy on her face as she embraces Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily's attribute must be...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Shoot, I forgot. Maybe his 'Nerdiness'!
She writes that on the chalkboard next to Owen then moves on to Ben's pair of photos, one of him playing basketball and another of him with a chemistry set. In both, his concentration is unwavering.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is Ben's attribute? It's his...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's definitely 'Strength'.
$ZOE falters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmm... I can't quite remember what she said. Athleticism, maybe?
Autumn shakes her head, the words pouring out of her.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No, Mr. Vanderwall... What you're thinking isn't true. I didn't have an agenda when I took Lindsay's photos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They're not ironic or deep or symbolic... They're just `pretty` photos.
nodes.text_bbcode: They're not ironic or deep or symbolic... They're just [color=#3b78e2][i]pretty[/i][/color] photos.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I didn't mean anything by them...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Vanderwall
nodes.text: Maybe not, but these are truly spectacular!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
